items: [Fun Drum Pad Machine] DED-20 electronic drum pad 's high-quality sound source sample is taken from a real drum source, faithfully reproducing the acoustic drum's sound. 7 drum sets(1 SNARE, 1 CRASH, 1 RIDE, 1 HI-HAT, and 3 TOMS), 12 demonstration songs, and 9 accompaniments were set up to accommodate the needs of performance and entertainment.

[2.2W Stereo Dual Speakers] The DED-20 electric drum pad has two fantastic stereo speakers that deliver the powerful, impactful sound you want. The volume of the electric drum set can be adjusted to 9 different levels and you can adjust the volume according to your needs. 180s-long recording function can record a drummer's Moment of inspiration and enhance their creative potential.

[Quiet, No Worry From Noise] Donner electronic drum pad is made of high-quality soft silicone, which can reduce the noise when drumming. It supports a 3.5mm headphone output, you can wear a set of headphones to improve your technique without disturbing your family, roommates, or neighbors. It is so easy to store that you can roll it up, and pack it in your bag.

[MIDI Connect & Gameplay] Come with standard midi out jack and USB midi out jack, you can connect the drum to computers to produce music or play games, or connect external speakers for family entertainment/birthday parties. Perfect for adults who need MIDI functionality and children for entertainment.

[40 Free and Entertaining Drum Lessons from Melodics] We have carefully created drum teaching courses for users ranging from beginner to advanced, which can effectively help drummers practice beats, build a good sense of music, and improve learning efficiency. 40 free and entertaining courses are sufficient to master all aspects of arrangement creation. Then comes your free time to create! Remember to get the course from customer service!

[Ideal Music Enlightenment Toy Gift For Kids] You can send the DED-20 electric drum set for your kids, families, and friends as gifts for Birthdays or Christmas. It contents:1 x electronic drum pad(mobile power charging support), 1 x power adapter, 1 x USB data cable, 1 x 3.5mm audio cable, 1 x drum sticks, 2 x drum pedals. Any questions contact us.
[Tip] The strike force of DED-20 is single and does not change as the strike force increases. We do not offer subscription services.
